name: [⚽ INTERNATIONAL] Become A Striker
desc:
⚽ Become A Striker — one chance at a time!

Start at 17 in the National League and draw your way to football glory 🏆

🎯 HOW IT PLAYS
- Play freezes at the big moments: draw a line to PASS, SHOOT or DRIBBLE
- Curl it into the top corner, thread through balls, skin defenders
- Penalties, free kicks over the wall, corners & headers

📈 YOUR CAREER
- Level up and boost Shooting, Passing, Dribbling & Pace
- 5 divisions: win promotion and get transfer offers from bigger clubs
- Earn a call-up for your country and play at the World Cup 🌍
- Chase the Golden Ball 🥇

🎁 CODES (join the group to redeem!)
⚽ GLOBALCUP – 3 Rewinds + 1 Extra Chance
⚽ PENALTYKING – 2 Extra Chances
⚽ EXTRATIME – 2 Rewinds
⚽ SAFEHANDS – 1 Rewind + 1 Extra Chance
⚽ LEGACY – 3 Rewinds
👍 Like & ⭐ favourite for more codes!

llm.loop: play freezes at key moments -> draw a line to pass, shoot or dribble -> earn XP and stat points -> win promotion and transfers -> reach the World Cup
llm.objectives: build a football career up to the World Cup and the Golden Ball
llm.progression: player stats, 5 divisions, transfers, national team call-up
llm.instructions: draw lines to pass/shoot/dribble at frozen moments; level up stats; redeem codes
unique: mobile-style draw-a-line football career on Roblox
llm.thumbnails: stylised striker shooting in a stadium, golden trophy shot, logo art, update in 1 hour icon
llm.complexity_notes: scripted match moments, ball trajectory drawing, career/division system
